scope: Exclusive resource-coalition creation through encoded document PNG availability; fresh process, empty private profile/cache, sealed HTTPS responses via one local SOCKS/TLS replay without forwarding, original author JavaScript enabled. Vox ends before PNG file write; Brave includes CDP PNG delivery and target/window setup. Readiness polling and two seconds of settlement are included; semantic audits and teardown follow the endpoint. Exited helpers and explicitly allowed coalition-owned services are included. GPU execution, observer/replay and outside services are excluded. The fixture records any shared JavaScript wall-clock override; monotonic timers remain real. OS filesystem/shader caches are retained. Per-engine references test stability; cross-browser pixel differences are reported separately.
